name: swiss-compliance-2026
display_name: Swiss Compliance 2026 — revised AMLA, LETA UBO register, FinSA/FinIA, nFADP
description: Structured knowledge graph for the 2026 wave of Swiss compliance reform: the revised AMLA (Anti-Money Laundering Act) and companion LETA (Loi fédérale sur la transparence des personnes morales) — both adopted by Federal Parliament 26 Sept 2025, central beneficial-ownership register and extended adviser obligations entering force mid-2026 and affecting ~600,000 entities. Plus the FinSA / FinIA conduct framework (FINMA's new FinSA conduct circular in force 1 Jan 2025), the nFADP data protection regime (in force since 1 Sept 2023), the DLT Act, Embargo Act / SECO sanctions, and Swiss Criminal Code financial-crime offences.
